temporal_guard_rationale: Every recording and acquisition date is assigned wholly to one split.
final_test_policy: No frames, proxy labels, aggregate metrics, or examples from final_test may be inspected until architecture, checkpoint selection, calibration, and thresholds are frozen.
scope_limit: All readable recordings are from the starvation project family. This split supports session/camera-shift evidence only and cannot establish cross-project or cross-background generalization.
